confirmation_classes.deterministic_high_pcode: A peripheral value is connected to an exact Source Buffer/Object by High P-code def-use and the register or API role is independently known.
confirmation_classes.trusted_summary: A generalized platform/API summary with versioned provenance is instantiated at a statically bound callsite.
confirmation_classes.heuristic_structural: Generalized structural evidence admits a possible ingress endpoint for backward DFA without claiming deterministic source semantics.
confirmation_classes.drop_local_heuristic: The candidate does not satisfy the local admission threshold; this is not proof that the value is internally generated.
confirmation_classes.raw_observation: MMIO/status/config access without a source-buffer proof; never enters sources.json.

notes: Core Source Miner must not directly confirm a source only because a function name matches a sample/framework-specific API.
Exact sample/framework function summaries are intentionally excluded from this core registry.
Those summaries may be reintroduced later only as explicit framework-assisted packs and must be reported separately from generic-only results.
Unknown MMIO addresses never become confirmed merely because their values are written into memory.
ISR naming is context evidence only; it does not prove peripheral ingress.

Every confirmed Source must bind a stable site_id and one typed output: ObjectId for memory, ValueId for a scalar, or the verified SiteId for an event. A memory buffer is not mandatory for scalar/control/event Sources.

body_derived_source_summaries.description: Infer source-producing functions from their body, not from exact API names. A function becomes a source summary when it writes a peripheral/MMIO data value into a formal buffer argument.

rules.description: A resolved call has two typed pointer/length pairs; one is exactly NULL/0 and the other binds a variable receive buffer and extent.
A function referenced by one initialized ELF object copies a static writable frame object into a pointer formal and returns a value derived from that copy extent.

ignore_or_raw_observation.name: status_polling_only
ignore_or_raw_observation.description: Status/control MMIO values used only in branch or polling conditions are raw observations, not confirmed sources.

ignore_or_raw_observation.name: init_config_only
ignore_or_raw_observation.description: init/config/setup/clock functions without source_buffer binding are ignored by the first source-miner interface.
